## Statements

- Stated by harness (cline-cli-reference, Help Menu, prompt argument and --auto-approve): A plain prompt runs in act mode with every tool auto-approved. Pass --auto-approve false or -p (plan mode) when the run must not change files.
- Stated by harness (cline-cli-reference, Global Options, --thinking row): Set reasoning effort per run with --thinking none, low, medium, high, or xhigh; the default is medium.
- Stated by harness (cline-cli-reference, CLINE_COMMAND_PERMISSIONS): CLINE_COMMAND_PERMISSIONS takes JSON allow and deny glob lists to restrict shell commands. Deny wins, and redirects stay blocked unless allowRedirects is true.
- Stated by harness (cline-cli-reference, Global Options, --timeout and --json rows): There is no timeout by default (-t 0). Set -t seconds so a stuck headless run ends, and use --json for line-delimited machine-readable messages.
